description:
Implement puncturing as a generic linear-code transformation over arbitrary coordinate sets, reusing the rank/information-set machinery from shortening.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Puncturing accepts arbitrary coordinate sets on any generic linear code, derives the resulting dimension by rank, reports the information-set structure, and preserves its coordinate map.
- [hard] REQ-02: Property tests verify rank-derived dimensions against direct matrix computation, including dimension-dropping cases, over binary and nonbinary codes.
title: Generic puncturing over arbitrary coordinate sets
